title: Bimatoprost for the Treatment of Eyebrow Hypotrichosis
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of bimatoprost solution compared with vehicle in the treatment of eyebrow hypotrichosis (inadequate eyebrows).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Adult participants with eyebrow hypotrichosis (inadequate eyebrow growth).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with disease, infection, or abnormality of the eyebrow area
* Patients with permanent eyebrow loss due to over-grooming
